skill.name: inngest
skill.description: Inngest expert for serverless-first background jobs, event-driven workflows, and durable execution without managing queues or workers. Use when: inngest, serverless background job, event-driven workflow, step function, durable execution.
skill.summary: Build reliable Inngest background jobs, workflows, schedules, and durable step functions.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The only static finding is a false positive. SKILL.md line 55 uses Markdown backticks around related skill names, not Ruby or shell execution. No evidence found of prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, or hidden malicious instructions.

content.value_statement: Teams need durable background jobs without managing queues or workers. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Inngest patterns for serverless workflows.
actual_capabilities: Design Inngest functions for typed events in Next.js.
Plan multi-step workflows with durable checkpoints and error handling.
Describe scheduled and cron-based Inngest functions.
Apply fan-out patterns for event-driven processing.
Address concurrency control for background workloads.
Flag common Inngest anti-patterns such as huge event payloads.
limitations: Does not include executable code or runnable templates.
Does not verify live Inngest account settings or deployment state.
Requires project-specific event schemas and framework details from the user.
Does not replace official Inngest documentation for version-specific APIs.

use_cases.title: Add Reliable Background Jobs
use_cases.description: Plan serverless jobs that survive retries and deployment boundaries.

use_cases.title: Design Event-Driven Workflows
use_cases.description: Map product events into durable steps, fan-out work, and failure handling.

use_cases.title: Review Workflow Architecture
use_cases.description: Check an Inngest design for payload size, concurrency, and step boundaries.

prompt_templates.title: Create a First Inngest Function
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me design a basic Inngest function for a Next.js app. My event is [event name], and the job should [goal].

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Multi-Step Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an Inngest workflow for [business process]. Include step boundaries, retry behavior, failure handling, and what each event should contain.

prompt_templates.title: Add Scheduling and Concurrency
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Inngest job plan for scheduled execution and concurrency control: [workflow summary]. Recommend limits, timing, and risk areas.

prompt_templates.title: Refactor a Complex Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Refactor this background processing design into durable Inngest functions: [current architecture]. Include events, fan-out strategy, idempotency, and observability.

output_examples.input: Design an onboarding workflow that sends email, waits three days, and checks activation.
output_examples.output: A step-by-step workflow plan with an onboarding event, email step, durable wait, activation check, retry notes, and cancellation considerations.

output_examples.input: Review my batch image analysis job for Inngest readiness.
output: Split the batch into event-driven fan-out work.
Keep payloads small and store large data externally.
Use concurrency limits for expensive analysis steps.
Add idempotency checks around result writes.

best_practices: Model workflows around events with small payloads and stable identifiers.
Use Inngest steps as durable checkpoints for retries and long-running work.
Set concurrency limits for jobs that call expensive or rate-limited services.
anti_patterns: Putting all workflow logic into one large function without durable steps.
Sending huge event payloads instead of references to stored data.
Ignoring concurrency when many events can trigger the same expensive work.

faq.question: What does this skill help me build?
faq.answer: It helps design Inngest background jobs, event-driven workflows, scheduled functions, and durable step-based processes.

faq.question: Does it include runnable code?
faq.answer: No. The skill provides expert guidance and patterns, but it does not ship executable source files.

faq.question: Can it help with Next.js projects?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill specifically references Inngest function setup with typed events in Next.js.

faq.question: Can it review existing workflow designs?
faq.answer: Yes. It can evaluate step boundaries, event payload size, fan-out, scheduling, and concurrency choices.

faq.question: Does it manage Inngest infrastructure?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on design guidance for serverless workflows and does not access accounts or deployments.
